alignments.note: Finite verb with its English subject pronoun under rule 17, headed on the lexical verb.
Waw rendered by the adversative *but* under rule 14.

The ASV recasts the clausal negation onto the subject nominal, so לֹא takes the *none* written for it (rule 15's negation-as-determiner reading). The margin's *but he answereth not* would put a plain *not* here, but the printed text governs under rule 38.
Light verb plus complement; head on *answer* under rule 44, since *giveth* alone gives anything.
מִפְּנֵי fused as one compound preposition under rule 30, headed on the construct noun; target head on *Because*, the word carrying the lexeme rather than the connective *of* (rule 24).
No article morpheme is present; the supplied *the* joins the noun it determines under rule 15.

Nomen rectum of the construct chain, so the *of* belongs here under rule 19; *men* is the generic supplied to make the adjective substantival, so the head stays on *evil* under rule 31. Heading on *men* was the competing reading, rejected because the ASV does not write *men* alone for רַע.

review_notes: Margin note *Or, but he answereth not* read and set aside under rule 38; the printed text's *none giveth answer* is what is aligned.
All 9 source and 14 target ids partitioned exactly once.
